constraints.description: The helper constructs an unanchored pattern; whole-value matching is owned by the consumer.
The selected target profile must support ordered regular-expression alternation.
Hexadecimal branches use explicit ASCII A-F, a-f, and 0-9 ranges.
Letter buckets use explicit ASCII A-Z and a-z ranges.
Punctuation and fixed letters are emitted as ASCII literals.
The selected target profile must support fixed and bounded quantifiers used by the helper.
The selected target profile must support noncapturing groups used by the compatibility pattern.
The emitted \d class deliberately retains the selected target engine's digit semantics.
